verdict.rationale: Highnote documents a Test environment that 'replicates the full functionality of the Live environment' and lets developers 'simulate real-time transactions', explicitly naming authorizations and refunds as simulatable. The other lifecycle stages the story asks for are not specifically documented as sandbox simulations. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox simulation of clearings, reversals, and declines; documentation of the simulation API or mutations; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can simulate the whole transaction lifecycle in the sandbox — authorizations, clearings, reversals, refunds, and declines — so my auth logic is tested before a real card ever swipes

citations.quote: The Highnote Test environment (or dashboard) replicates the full functionality of the Live environment, and lets you simulate real-time transactions and compliance scenarios.
Simulate authorizations, refunds, and statements before you talk to anyone.
